verdict.rationale: The evidence supports parallel, many-at-once work only indirectly: agent mode edits files across the workspace, tasks can be assigned to multiple background agents and tracked from one control page, and automations can trigger the cloud agent on schedules or repository events. No doc describes an explicit bulk operation, such as applying one action to many issues, PRs or repositories in a single command. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented bulk/batch operation across many items, evidence of multi-repo or multi-issue fan-out in one action, hands-on or independent corroboration.
